patches_added.name: Trust re-signed browsers for passkeys
patches_added.description: Lets you trust a Morphe-patched (re-signed) browser for passkeys. Normally Bitwarden hard-fails such a browser with "signature does not match" and offers no way to trust it; this routes it to the standard "trust this browser?" prompt instead, so you approve it once and it's remembered. Browsers whose signature already matches are unaffected.

patches_modified.name: No screen lock passkey
patches_modified.description: Skips the master password / PIN prompt for Bitwarden passkey sign-in and creation on a device with no secure lock screen. Devices with a PIN, pattern, password, or biometric lock are unchanged.

patches_added.name: 120 refresh rate
patches_added.description: Lifts the 60 Hz limit Maps puts on itself, on the app and on the map, so it can run at your screen's full refresh rate (such as 120 Hz). Uses more battery, most of all while navigating. Off by default: switch it on on the Customization screen.

patches_added.name: Account sheet cleanup
patches_added.description: Removes the "More from this app" label from the account sheet, and keeps the sheet open when you come back from Settings or Customization or tap "Your profile", instead of dropping back to the map.

patches_added.name: Add microG-RE support
patches_added.description: Signs in to your Google account through microG-RE (MicroG-RE or ReVanced GmsCore), keeping the name from Change app name. Not for root installs; for original microG, use Add original microG support.

patches_added.name: Add original microG support
patches_added.description: Signs in through original microG on ROMs with signature spoofing. Keeps Maps' own package name; allow signature spoofing for it.

patches_added.name: Any media app
patches_added.description: Navigation's Default media app (Settings > Navigation) offers every music and podcast app that works with Android Auto, such as Poweramp, also where Google switches media controls off. YouTube Music and Spotify only connect to Google's own Maps.

patches_added.name: Avoid Flock cameras
patches_added.description: Steers driving directions around Flock cameras: when Google's route passes one, a camera-free way is worked out with BRouter, an OpenStreetMap router, and Maps asks Google again for a route through it, so Google still times and navigates the trip, and keeps it through reroutes. A detour longer than half again the distance is dropped. Off until turned on in Waze & external data source, with Flock cameras; your route's start and end go to brouter.de. Trips with stops are left as they are.

patches_added.name: Better offline maps
patches_added.description: Reworks the offline area picker: zooming out really selects more instead of being shrunk to Google's size cap, the box can be resized by dragging its edges and corners, a large area is split into several downloads whose true total size is shown, and areas already downloaded are drawn on the map. Can be turned off on the Customization screen.

patches_added.name: Black theme
patches_added.description: AMOLED-black theme. Pins Maps' own dark mode and its separate navigation colour scheme, and remaps colour resources, drawable fills and draw-time paints so no surface is left grey.

patches_added.name: Blue pin
patches_added.description: Chromium-coloured flat map pin on every in-app product logo and the search bar's leading icon.

patches_added.name: Bypass Play Services checks
patches_added.description: Makes Maps' bundled Play services signature and availability checks always pass, so it runs re-signed and with Play services disabled or absent, and lets it load tiles, search and routing by sending Google's own package and certificate in the identity headers the Maps backend checks. Where Play services rejects the re-signed app, Maps degrades instead of crashing. Also skips Google's "isn't Play Protect certified" page, and with no Play services at all uses Android's own Cronet so the map still loads.

patches_added.name: Change app name
patches_added.description: Sets the launcher and app-switcher name, with a choice of launcher icon styles on light or dark backgrounds.

patches_added.name: Change package name
patches_added.description: Installs alongside stock Google Maps under its own package name. On by default, because stock Maps comes built into most phones and cannot be replaced by a patched copy.

patches_added.name: Customization screen
patches_added.description: Adds a Customization row under Settings on the account sheet, with switches for the patches here that can be turned back off inside the app.

patches_added.name: Flock cameras
patches_added.description: Puts Flock and other license plate reader cameras on the map, from OpenStreetMap -- the cameras DeFlock's volunteers map -- and chimes and shows a note when one is coming up ahead. Off until turned on in Waze & external data source, a row on the account sheet, because it downloads the ones near you from an OpenStreetMap server, over the same area as the speed cameras.

patches_added.name: Follow playing media
patches_added.description: Navigation's media controls show what an app is playing, also apps that refuse Maps such as Pocket Casts and TIDAL. Needs notification access (Customization), not on root mount installs.

patches_added.name: Hide ads and clutter
patches_added.description: Hides promoted map pins (on the map, in search results and along a route) and "Sponsored" search results, Gemini's AI summaries ("Know before you go" and the review summary), the row of businesses under an address on its place sheet, the home tab's Explore feed and the Explore / Contribute / You tabs. Each can be switched back on on the Customization screen.

patches_added.name: Legacy icon
patches_added.description: Uses the flat multicolour pin Maps had before the 2025 gradient icon as the launcher icon and on the screen Maps opens with. With Add microG-RE support, microG's C sits in the pin's circle.

patches_added.name: Location provider toggle
patches_added.description: Adds a Location source choice to the Customization screen: Android's own location providers, microG-RE's or Google Play services' fused provider. With Android, neither is ever asked for a location. A source that is missing or disabled is never used, so location keeps working without it. Also keeps the network (Wi-Fi/cell) provider registered when no fused provider answers, instead of GPS only, so a fix does not go stale indoors.

patches_added.name: Native navigation for Gearslip and Android Auto
patches_added.description: Shows this patched Maps app's live native map with app-owned car UI and standard navigation controls that Android Auto and compatible hosts can arrange.

patches_added.name: Offline saved places
patches_added.description: Save places without a Google account, kept only on the phone: Save opens Maps' own "Place saved" sheet (Want to go, Travel plans, Starred places, Favorites, your own lists, a note), and a "Local saved" row on the account sheet rebuilds Maps' You tab -- your recent places, your lists and labels (Home, Work, your own) -- with export and import (backup file, KML, Google Takeout's saved lists and Saved Places.json, several files or the whole Takeout .zip at once). It also has a Timeline: where the phone has been, grouped into days and visits, kept only on the phone, with GPX export. Recording is off until switched on there; it shows a notification while it runs. With Add microG-RE support, Maps' own Save keeps syncing to your account and Local saved instead copies the account's saved lists to the phone (Pull from Google account).

patches_added.name: Power saving mode
patches_added.description: Brings the Pixel-only power saving mode to every phone: while driving with navigation, press the power button and Maps shows only key information such as the next turn on a black screen. Turn it on or off in Settings > Navigation > Power saving mode. Pixels that have it built in keep Google's own version unless Power saving mode is turned on in Power Saving Options, a row on the account sheet under Customization, which also has: a navigation button that opens the power saving screen without locking the phone, switching to it by itself when idle, a speedometer on it, a lower frame rate, and its black map in navigation or all over Maps.

patches_added.name: Proxy
patches_added.description: Adds a Proxy screen to Customization that sends Maps' own traffic, map data included, through an HTTP proxy -- for example Orbot's (127.0.0.1:8118) to use Tor. Map data never falls back to a direct connection: if the proxy stops, Maps stops loading. Needs a recent Play services network engine (Cronet); Maps warns when it cannot take the proxy.

patches_added.name: Rectangle shapes
patches_added.description: Squares off rounded corners across the UI, including the two round navigation buttons.

patches_added.name: Remove permissions
patches_added.description: Removes permissions that only serve Google-account features or Google's data collection: background location, physical activity, contacts, microphone (voice search stops working), camera (Lens and Live View stop working), car speed, advertising ID, push messages and Google services settings. Left out with Add microG-RE support, whose account features need them.

patches_added.name: Remove sign-in prompts
patches_added.description: Removes Google's sign-in prompts: the first-launch "Make it your map" page, the search screen's "Tired of typing?" card and the account sheet's "Sign in" pill. Tapping "Your profile" (or the pill, where it still shows) answers with a "Can't sign in" toast instead of nothing. With Add microG-RE support, which signs in, only the first-launch page and the card go.

patches_added.name: Remove telemetry
patches_added.description: Points the Firebase Installations and Play services compliance check-ins at an unresolvable host, stops every ad impression and click ping from being sent, and deregisters Google's logging, performance-monitoring, survey and Location History libraries and the on-device federated-learning services. With Add microG-RE support, Firebase Installations and Location History are left alone, so Timeline, account sync and push messages keep working.

patches_added.name: Speed cameras
patches_added.description: Chimes and shows a note when a speed or red light camera is coming up ahead, and puts the cameras on the map, from OpenStreetMap. Off until turned on in Waze & external data source, a row on the account sheet, because it downloads the cameras near you from an OpenStreetMap server -- an area you choose there, about 25 to 175 km across.

patches_added.name: Speeding chime
patches_added.description: Plays a chime when your speed passes the speed limit during navigation, as Waze does. Maps itself only turns its speedometer red. When it chimes is chosen in Waze & external data source, a row on the account sheet.

patches_added.name: Trim account menu
patches_added.description: Removes Your Timeline, Location sharing, Your data in Maps and Help & feedback from the account sheet. Left out with Add microG-RE support, whose account features need them.

patches_added.name: Use the system voice for navigation
patches_added.description: Uses the phone's selected text-to-speech engine for Maps navigation instead of requiring Google TTS. Select DriveDeck in Android's text-to-speech settings to hear Maps with the local DriveDeck voice. If no system engine is ready, Maps keeps its original voice.

patches_added.name: Waze alerts
